name: Hitozuma Daisakusen
source:
Main character is a young man who goes to part-time job and loves listening to late night radio show with DJ Nekota. One night DJ starts to call for intimacy with married women, and protagonist runs into the night as if infused with some power.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个年轻人，白天做兼职，晚上喜欢收听猫田DJ的深夜广播。某晚，DJ开始呼吁大家和已婚女性亲密接触，主人公仿佛获得某种力量，冲入夜色。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndreview[/url]]
